---
pagetitle: "antony-mathematics"
description: "Notes and essays on mathematics: number theory, analysis, and whatever I'm proving this week."
page-layout: full
toc: false
title-block-banner: false
body-classes: am-home
listing:
  - id: latest
    contents: posts
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 6
    template: _templates/latest.ejs
    fields: [title, subtitle, date, description, categories, reading-time, path]
  - id: notebook-latest
    contents: notes
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 4
    template: _templates/notes-mini.ejs
    fields: [title, date, description, path]
  - id: problem-of-the-day
    contents: problems
    sort: "date desc"
    template: _templates/problems.ejs
    template-params:
      id: am-problem-today
    date-format: iso
    max-description-length: 600
    fields: [title, date, categories, description, path]
  - id: topic-grid
    contents: posts
    sort: "date desc"
    template: _templates/topic-grid.ejs
    fields: [title, categories, path]
---
